- Unused infrastructure: `internal/scheduler/` is a full cron-based job scheduler package that is never imported or used by the server. The `server/runner/memopayload/` Runner struct also exists but is never started as a background worker (only its `RebuildMemoPayload` function is called per-request inline).

- memos.memo.comment.created: `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook`
- All converge to `webhook.Post` / `webhook.PostAsync` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`
